messages:
Aisha (Finance): Heads up — CloudMeter invoice looks off. We expected $12,300 in usage credits for Feb but the invoice only shows $3,400. Attaching invoice: https://s3.redwood/invoices/CloudMeter_Feb_2026.pdf @Connor can you take first pass?

Connor (Billing): On it. I saw a note about 'reserved commit' vs 'on-demand' mixing. I'll reconcile our usage logs against their portal. @Lina did Procurement sign the addendum that changes credit tier?

Lina (Procurement): Yes we signed the Q1 commit addendum on Feb 9. PDF in procurement drive: /procure/CloudMeter/Q1-addendum.pdf

Aisha (Finance): I think credits should've applied pro-rata to the RDW-PLAT account. Invoice line 14 shows `Credit - promotional` $3,400. The expected credit per our spreadsheet is $12,300.

Connor (Billing): I'm pulling a query now: `SELECT sum(credits_applied) FROM cloudmeter_billing WHERE month='2026-02'` - will post results when done.

BillingBot: Query results: credits_applied_total = $3,400. Possible causes: addendum not linked to billing account, or different contract id referenced.

Aisha (Finance): I pinged Emma at CloudMeter billing (email) — waiting to see if they linked contract id incorrectly.

Emma (CloudMeter): Hi folks — sorry for the delay. Found root cause: the addendum referenced contract CM-2025-A which is an old contract ID. We applied credits to that account only. We can reissue a corrected invoice and apply a one-time adjustment of $8,900 to RDW-PLAT if you confirm that is the target account.

Connor (Billing): Can you confirm the pro‑rata calc? Our internal expected $12,300 — how did you get $8,900?

Emma (CloudMeter): Our reconciliation shows we applied monthly credits for active days under RDW-PLAT starting Feb 10, so it's prorated from Feb 10–28. The $12,300 number assumed full-month credits. We'll send the detailed line-by-line calc in a follow-up.

Jorge (Legal): If their effective date is Feb 10 and the addendum states that, that's consistent. Procurement should confirm the effective date on the signed doc. Lina?

Lina (Procurement): Our signed copy in Drive has "Effective date: Feb 1" in section 2. I'll pull the signed PDF and screenshot the page in case of version mismatch.

Aisha (Finance): OK — to keep us organized: Action items -> 1) Connor: reconcile usage and post exact expected credit amount; 2) Lina: confirm effective date & attach signed page; 3) Emma: send a corrected invoice draft + detailed calc showing how you got $8,900; 4) Jorge: legal to confirm acceptance of one-time adjustment before finance applies it. Can people commit to timelines?

Connor (Billing): I'll have the reconciliation by EOD today (1782007967).

Lina (Procurement): I'll pull the signed doc and post a screenshot of section 2 in ~30m.

Emma (CloudMeter): I'll push the corrected invoice draft and detailed calc by EOD and cc billing@cloudmeter.com.

Aisha (Finance): :thumbsup: Thanks. For traceability I'm pasting the invoice snippet we flagged:
```
Invoice #CM-2026-02
12  Usage Charges         $45,200
13  Reserved Commit Credit - full month  ($15,000)
14  Credit - promotional            ($3,400)
15  Taxes & Fees                $1,024
Total due: $27,824
```

Aisha (Finance): Please keep updates in this thread so we have a single source of truth.

Emma (CloudMeter): Understood. Will update here once the draft invoice is ready.

Connor (Billing): Posting interim reconciliation numbers in 10m.

Lina (Procurement): Screenshot posted — signed effective date shows Feb 1 in our copy.

Aisha (Finance): If Procurement confirms Feb 1, then we should push CloudMeter to reapply full credit for Feb. If they argue Feb 10, we need their calc in writing.

Emma (CloudMeter): Draft invoice uploaded to their portal and emailed. Calc attached in the email thread.

Jorge (Legal): Once we have the corrected invoice and calc, I'll greenlight acceptance or request amendment.

Aisha (Finance): Thanks everyone — pausing here until Connor posts the reconciliation and Emma's calc.
